_comment: Exact misspellings of well-known mail domains and what they should be. Only entries on this list are suggested; nothing is guessed by edit distance, so a real domain such as gmail.co is never misjudged by a rule that does not know it. Changing this file or provider.go means RulesVersion in rules.go goes up. The BASIS crawler can read this same file (FORK.md, LST-53). Left out on purpose: names that belong to a real company or are one letter from one (naber.com is Naber GmbH, nave.com), because refusing them refuses real people.

tld._comment: Top-level labels that are not real and are one slip from com. The domain keeps its name and gets .com.
